description: Returns workout programs (collections) for the authenticated user's team, filterable by difficulty, length, visibility, tags and AI stamp. Use when the user asks to see programs, training plans, or workout collections. Not for publisher programs (use list_stock_programs).

ai_stamp.description: AI stamp filter: "fit" = AI-made and meets all of the team's programming rules; "partial" = AI-made, meets some; "none" = no AI stamp.

difficulties.description: Only show these levels, e.g. ["beginner", "intermediate"]. Omit for all levels.

duration_in_weeks.description: Only show programs this many weeks long, e.g. 4.

locale.description: Language for names and text, as a locale code, e.g. "en-US", "de-DE" or "de". Omit for the default language.

page.description: Page number, starting at 1. Defaults to 1.

per_page.description: Results per page, 1 to 100. Defaults to 10.

search_text.description: Text to search names for, e.g. "core". Omit to list everything.

sort_by.description: Field to sort by: "name", "updatedAt" (last edited), "durationInWeeks", "workoutsPerWeek", "difficulty" or "visibility".

sort_order.description: Sort direction: "ascend" (A to Z, lowest or oldest first) or "descend" (reverse).

tags.description: Only show items with any of these tags (exact match, any case), e.g. ["hiit"]. Omit for all.

team_id.description: Team to act on. Omit to use the signed-in team.

visibility.description: Only show these visibilities, e.g. ["private"]. Omit for both.

workouts_per_week.description: Only show programs with this many workouts per week, 1 to 7.

name: list_team_programs
title: List team programs
